verdict.rationale: The pack shows release-numbered documentation, such as the Python API reference labeled "Unreal Python 5.8" and marked Experimental, plus a public roadmap. Nothing documents an API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy, so an AI-native user has no stated stability contract to rely on. Release-versioned docs are adjacent evidence, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
